translations.docs.title: jest-angular-forms — documentation
translations.docs.description: Technical reference for Jest matchers for Angular Reactive Forms.
translations.docs.examples.heading: Usage examples
translations.docs.examples.intro: Paths follow AbstractControl.get() syntax, including nested groups and FormArray indexes.
translations.docs.footer: Source code and issue tracking on GitHub.
translations.docs.api.heading: API reference
translations.docs.api.intro: Matchers return an assertion result with a failure message and support .not. Methods taking multiple paths accept strings and arrays of strings.
translations.docs.api.groups.0.title: Structure and state
translations.docs.api.groups.0.matchers.0.description: The control exists at the given path.
translations.docs.api.groups.0.matchers.2.description: The control exists and is enabled.
translations.docs.api.groups.0.matchers.3.description: The control exists and is disabled.
translations.docs.api.groups.1.title: Validation
translations.docs.api.groups.1.matchers.2.description: The control has the same ValidatorFn reference.
translations.docs.api.groups.1.matchers.3.description: The control has all ValidatorFn references.
translations.docs.api.groups.1.matchers.4.description: The control has the error in its current state.
translations.docs.api.groups.1.matchers.5.description: The control has all errors in its current state.
translations.docs.api.groups.1.matchers.6.description: The FormGroup has the error in its current state.
translations.docs.api.groups.2.title: Values
translations.docs.notes.heading: Behavior details
translations.docs.notes.paths: Paths are resolved with FormGroup.get(). Examples: profile.name and addresses.0.street. A missing path fails the assertion.
translations.docs.notes.validators: toHaveValidator and toHaveValidators use hasValidator(), which compares function references. Store and reuse the ValidatorFn instance assigned to the control.
translations.docs.notes.errors: Error matchers use hasError() against the current validation state. They do not trigger validation themselves.
translations.docs.notes.values: toHaveFormValue compares form.value, which omits disabled controls. toHaveRawValue uses getRawValue() and includes them. Jest performs deep equality.
translations.docs.notes.negation: Standard Jest negation works too: expect(form).not.toBeValidForm().
translations.docs.overview.heading: Jest matchers for Angular Reactive Forms
translations.docs.overview.summary: The library adds FormGroup-specific assertions to Jest expect. It covers control structure, validators, errors, and values without repeating form.get() calls in every test.
translations.docs.overview.scope: Every matcher receives a FormGroup in expect(form). Register them once in the Jest setup file with registerAngularFormMatchers().
translations.docs.setup.heading: Installation and configuration
translations.docs.setup.intro: Install the package as a development dependency in the project running the tests.
translations.docs.setup.configNote: Include the setup file in tsconfig.spec.json as well so TypeScript can see the matcher declarations. If your tests use Zone.js, initialize that environment before calling registerAngularFormMatchers().
